findings.description: Multiplication on the result of a division: scaled = scaled * 1e18 / exchangeRate (712) then scaled = scaled / (10 ** (18 - decimals)) (717). Two sequential truncating divisions in the 18-dec -> token-dec denormalization path; rounds toward zero twice. Paired with _normalizeAmount (665-691) which applies the inverse ops in the opposite order, so round-trip is lossy and asymmetric for low-decimal tokens (USDC/USDT, 6 dec).

nonReentrant is not the first modifier on claim(): order is `whenNotPaused nonReentrant`. Guard is present and effective; whenNotPaused is a pure storage read with no external call, so no reentrancy window exists ahead of the guard. Ordering nit only.

External calls inside unbounded loops: yieldStrategy.getAuthorizedClients() (637), totalBalanceOf (640), principalOf (641), iterated over yieldStrategies[] and per-strategy client arrays. Reachable from claim(), getYield(), getTotalYield(), canClaim(). Growth in registered strategies or authorized clients is owner-driven and unbounded -> gas-exhaustion DoS on the claim path (owner footgun, Law 3).
